changeSet.author: alexander.stanik@htw-berlin.de
changeSet.comment: Contractor↔Organization linking is now keyed by email, mirroring Tenant↔User: an organization's email must be globally unique so it can serve as a reliable matching key, and a contractor's email (and the organization it resolves to) must be unique per project so at most one contractor record per project can represent a given organization. All three columns are nullable, so partial (filtered) unique indexes are used to exclude NULLs from the uniqueness check. Replaces the now-redundant plain index idx_contractor_organization_fk.
